I'm a data analyst with more than four years of experience in analytics, first
in pricing and operations at Parkland Corporation and then in the cruise
industry at Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings and Royal Caribbean Group. My work
centers on turning large, messy operational data into dashboards, models and
recommendations that planning teams can act on.

- **Senior Data Analyst**, Royal Caribbean Group (2026 to present)
- **Data Analyst**, Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings (2024 to 2026)
- **Business Analyst**, Parkland Corporation (2022 to 2024)
- **M.S. in Applied Business Analytics**, Boston University (expected October 2026)
- **B.B.A. in Finance**, Florida International University (2023)
